data.titulo: Bildad on God’s Dominion and Human Frailty

data.text: “Dominion and dread are with him; he makes peace in his heights.
Can his armies be numbered? On whom does his light not rise?
How then can a mortal be in the right before God? How can one born of woman be pure?
Look, even the moon does not shine, and the stars are not pure in his eyes.
How much less a mortal, a maggot, and a son of man, a worm!”
